title: Jack-Jack and Becca's Cruise Adventure
tagline: I have a card. I follow it. I can do it myself.

parts.name: Part 1: Packing
parts.blurb: The packing-video storyboard, turned into play. The kids do every step with their own finger.

parts.name: Part 2: The trip
parts.blurb: After the real vacation (leaves November 10). Trip photos and memories shape each chapter.

panels.picture: VHS color bars, then the retro title card: "Packing Your Suitcase: Training for New Associates"
Jack and Becca, wide-eyed, looking at a poster of a giant cruise ship
panels.dad: Very soon, we board a giant ship. Your job is to pack your own suitcase.

panels.picture: Each kid holding their own picture checklist card
panels.dad: This is your card. It shows everything you need.

panels.picture: Poster with four icons: eye, hand, suitcase, checkmark
panels.dad: Look. Find. Pack. Check. Say it with me.

panels.picture: Jack looks at his card, then pulls clothes from his dresser
panels.dad: Look at your card. Find it.

panels.picture: Jack rolls a shirt, shorts, underwear, and socks into a burrito, packs it, checks the box
panels.dad: Roll it like a burrito. Pack it. Check it.

panels.picture: Becca drops in six bundles, holding up fingers to count
panels.dad: Six bundles. Count with me. One, two, three...

panels.picture: Becca packs pajamas and hugs them first
panels.dad: What's next on your card? ... Pajamas!

panels.picture: Jack holds his swimsuit and pretends to swim
Jack packs his hoodie; Becca twirls with her dress
panels.dad: A jacket for chilly nights. One nice outfit.

panels.picture: Both kids tuck in sandals and try on sun hats
Becca with her hairbrush, Jack with his toothbrush
Becca packs her bunny and her special ears; Jack packs a toy car and a book
panels.dad: One buddy. One thing for the plane. One special thing.

panels.picture: Jack's suitcase overflowing with toys, Jack sitting on it and it won't close
panels.dad: Uh oh. Something went wrong. What do we do? ... Check your card!

panels.picture: Becca holding up four swimsuits, her card showing underwear not checked
panels.dad: Becca, how many swimsuits does your card show?

panels.picture: Both fixed: toys put back, underwear in, kids sitting proudly on closed suitcases
panels.dad: Look. Find. Pack. Check. You fixed it.

panels.picture: Dad holds the cards up to the suitcases and stamps them "APPROVED"
On the ship: kids in swimsuits by the pool, then in pajamas in the cabin
panels.dad: Who packed that swimsuit? You did.

panels.picture: End card: "Training complete. Please return to your parents."
